name: Centaur Bounty
summary: After Khan Dez'hepah, Felgur Twocuts says the scared centaur clans must now be bled. Hunt centaur of any clan across Desolace and bring Felgur fifteen of their ears.

sections.title: Time to Bleed Them
sections.body: Felgur Twocuts says that now the centaur clans have been scared, it is time to bleed them. Whenever you travel Desolace, hunt centaur. Felgur does not care which clan you hunt, only that you gather ears, fifteen of them. Thinning their numbers will weaken their resolve and put an end to any thoughts of expansion.

sections.title: Felgur's Verdict
sections.body: When you return, Felgur says the centaur must by now know your name, and respect and fear it. They know the banner you ride under as well: the Horde's.

faq.q: Who orders this bounty on the centaur?
faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts, in Desolace. Fifteen centaur ears are to be brought back to Felgur.

faq.q: Which centaur clans need to be hunted?
faq.answer: Any of them. Felgur does not care which clan you hunt, only that you gather ears.

faq.q: Why does Felgur want so many centaur ears?
faq.answer: To weaken the centaur numbers. Fewer centaur means weaker resolve, and it stamps out any thoughts of expansion.
It follows Khan Dez'hepah. Felgur says the centaur clans have been scared, and now it is time to bleed them.
